title: Bounded Pilot
summary: Introduces PBHP in one defined decision context before organization-wide rollout.
mechanism: An 8–12 week pilot defines scope, trains operators, collects receipts, logs false positives and overrides, measures burden and defect detection, and scales only after evidence.
test_status: The adoption design is specified; controlled field evidence remains open.
next_tests: Measure burden, defects, overrides, and outcomes
Use independent review of the pilot report
